SPECIFICATION
PART II

FOR LOUDSPEAKERS

DIRECT RADIATOR MOVING COIL LOUDSPEAKERS

0.

FOREWORD

0.1 This Indian Standard ( Part II ) was adopted by the Indian Standards Institution on 28 August 1975, after the draft finalized by the Acoustics Sectional Committee had been approved by the Electrotechnical Division Council. 0.2 The object of this standard is to specify performance direct radiator moving coil loudspeakers as regards mechanical, climatic and acoustical properties. requirements of their electrical,

0.3 This standard ( Part II ) shall be read in conjunction with IS : 7741 ( Part I ) - 1975" which covers the general requirements and methods of measurement. 0.4 Originally IS : 1033 - 1957 covered the direct radiator moving coil loudspeakers and is now being superseded by this standard. While preparing this standard the latest developments in testing methods and experience gained in the implementation of IS : 1033 - 1957 were taken into account. 0.5 For the purpose of deciding whether a particular requirement of this standard is complied with, the final value, observed or calculated, expressing the result of a test, shall be rounded off in accordance with IS : 2-l 96Ot. The number of significant places retained in the rounded off value should be the same as that of the specified value in this standard.

1. SCOPE 1.1 This standard specifies the performance requirements for direct radiator permanent magnet moving coil loudspeakers regarding its acoustical, electrical, mechanical and climatic properties.
*Specification for loudspeakers : Part I General requirements and tests. TRules for rounding off numerical values ( revised).

3

IS : 7741 ( Part II ) - 1975 1.2 Unless otherwise stated, the loudspeaker shall be understood to include both loudspeaker elements and loudspeaker systems comprising one or more loudspeaker elements and such relevant devices as built-in cross-over filters, transformers and any other passive elements.
1.3 Dimensional requirements are not covered in the standard.
